name: spine-field-types
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.field-types drove only domain.value.field-type; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.service.template-registry (the field types are declared by the template schema the registry owns). Added `implemented-by` solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.parseManifestField (decodes a `template.yaml` field, its type and its options). Path: field-types -> template-registry -> solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.parseManifestField. Existing `drives` to domain.value.field-type kept.
